high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage or article. The content discusses the concept of "social immunity" in relation to the prevention and management of infections within insect societies. The text explains that social immunity, similar to individual immunity, initially aims to prevent the onset and spread of infections. However, when infections break through this early defense, social immunity shifts to isolate and eliminate infected individuals, resorting to extreme measures like killing if care fails.
